binders: w is an arbitrary curried function from Real to Real to Real, interpreted as w(x,t).
c, x, and t are arbitrary real numbers, with x and t serving as the point for the first conjunct.
Within the second conjunct, profile is an arbitrary function Real to Real and y and s are arbitrary real numbers.
Within the first biconditional, wt and wx are existentially quantified real derivative witnesses, and all subsequent conditions in that existential scope use those same witnesses.
hypotheses: For each profile, y, and s in the second conjunct, the inner hypothesis is 0<s.
No continuity, differentiability, measurability, or other regularity is assumed of w or profile.
conclusions: LocalDef001(w,c,x,t) holds if and only if there exist real numbers wt and wx such that the time slice tau |-> w(x,tau) has derivative wt at t, the space slice xi |-> w(xi,t) has derivative wx at x, and wt+c*wx=0.

For every profile:Real->Real and all real y,s with 0<s, both y<y+c*s and LocalDef002(profile,c,y+c*s,s)=profile(y) hold. Since LocalDef002(profile,c,z,r)=profile(z-c*r), the equality is profile((y+c*s)-c*s)=profile(y).
mathematical_definitions: LocalDef003(q,v,x,t) means that q has separate one-variable derivatives qt in time and qx in space at (x,t), witnessed existentially, and these satisfy qt+v*qx=0.
HasDerivAt(f,d,a) means that the one-variable function f has derivative d at a; in this real specialization it is the usual point derivative.
The scalar action of a real number on a real number is ordinary real multiplication, so c acting on wx is c*wx.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every real-valued function w of a spatial and a temporal real variable, and every real speed c and point (x,t), if c is positive, then two claims hold. First, the local predicate LocalDef001 at (w,c,x,t) is equivalent to the existence of the separate time and space derivatives of w at that point whose values satisfy wt+c*wx=0. Because LocalDef001 abbreviates exactly that existential predicate, this equivalence is definitional. Second, for every real profile, starting location y, and positive time increment s, y is strictly less than y+c*s and evaluating the shifted-profile construction profile(z-c*r) at z=y+c*s and r=s returns profile(y). The second equality is the algebraic identity profile((y+c*s)-c*s)=profile(y); the inequality follows from c>0 and s>0.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The entire conjunction is under the implication 0<c; for c<=0 the proposition is vacuously true and makes no claim.
The profile conclusion is under 0<s; for s<=0 its implication is vacuous.

The first conjunct is pointwise at the single chosen (x,t) and asks only for derivatives of the two coordinate slices. It does not assert joint differentiability, differentiability on a neighborhood or domain, or a global evolution law.
The biconditional does not compare two independently defined notions: LocalDef001 unfolds to the exact existential predicate on its right, so it is a definitional restatement.
The profile equality is true by unfolding LocalDef002 and simplifying real arithmetic; it places no regularity condition on profile.
The strict inequality uses both positivity assumptions. The equality itself does not require either c>0 or s>0.

The two top-level conjuncts are not linked by w or by a shared profile. The second conjunct quantifies a fresh arbitrary profile and does not assert that LocalDef002 constructed from it satisfies LocalDef001, nor that it agrees with w.
The variables w, x, and t do not occur in the second conjunct, while the first conjunct uses profile, y, and s not at all.
No initial condition, boundary condition, uniqueness claim, existence of a global solution, or relationship between w and data at time zero is encoded.
